第三方设计参考与许可证声明

V39 / 2026-10-28 — spatial intro runtime
纸间行旅：原创场景逻辑与几何表现，不包含 purplenoggin.com 的代码、人物、模型、纹理或品牌素材。
该站只作为动效参考；未将其未知授权的自定义场景当作开源模板复制。
Three.js 0.186.1 — https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js — MIT.
Locally minified official ESM module/core, with original filenames and inline legal comments.
Full unchanged license: assets/vendor/three-0.186.1/LICENSE.txt.
GSAP 3.15.0 / ScrollTrigger — https://github.com/greensock/GSAP.
License: Standard "No Charge" GSAP License, not MIT: https://gsap.com/standard-license/.
Locally minified pure ESM gsap-core.js, CSSPlugin.js, ScrollTrigger.js and Observer.js retain inline legal comments.
The scene animates Three.js numeric values and registers CSSPlugin for ScrollTrigger's DOM utilities.
The index.js entry and browser-global UMD files are not included.
Upstream README: assets/vendor/gsap-3.15.0/README.md.
Runtime, version and originality notice: assets/vendor/gsap-3.15.0/NOTICE.txt.
esbuild 0.28.2 — https://github.com/evanw/esbuild — MIT, development-only minification tool.
Versions are fixed in the source lockfile. No scene CDN or React runtime is included.
No upstream author is represented as participating in or endorsing this website.

ROUND 4 / 2026-10-22 — actual use, evaluated alternatives
Scores are our fit assessment for this portfolio, not GitHub ratings or popularity.
Fuse.js 7.5.0 — 86/100 — https://github.com/krisk/Fuse (Apache-2.0)
Actual unchanged Basic distribution: assets/vendor/fuse.basic.min.mjs.
Full license: assets/vendor/Fuse-LICENSE.txt. Commit 45bac9fe2e71fe8c680c861a35a8b226c4ae6d5a.
Loaded locally on first search open; input remains in the browser and is not sent to a search service.
axe-core 4.14.0 — 89/100 — https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core (MPL-2.0)
Development-only accessibility checks. Not shipped in dist; source includes a local QA preparation script.
AutoAnimate 0.10.0 — 77/100 — https://github.com/formkit/auto-animate (MIT)
Reference only: brief state transitions. The site uses native CSS and its existing motion controls, not AutoAnimate code.
PhotoSwipe 5.4.4 — 70/100 — https://github.com/dimsemenov/PhotoSwipe (MIT)
Embla Carousel 8.6.0 — 61/100 — https://github.com/davidjerleke/embla-carousel (MIT)
Both evaluated but not included: current two main projects remain directly visible, with native expandable project descriptions.
Round 4 weights: user value 30, interaction 20, accessibility 20, performance fit 15, maintenance 15.

ROUND 3 / 2026-10-22 — implementation and design references
以下分数为本站适配判断，不是 GitHub 官方评级或星数。
Lucide 93/100: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
Actual asset use: 11 local SVG symbols, fixed commit 20aef31db93fe4d9f398dbb15b120d99c48eef95.
Full ISC and Feather-origin MIT notices: assets/lucide-LICENSE.txt.
No icon JavaScript runtime or CDN is shipped.

Astro Nano 90/100: https://github.com/markhorn-dev/astro-nano (MIT)
Reference only: static-first delivery, clear contact actions, structured metadata. Astro/Tailwind source and runtime are not included.
Motion 88/100: https://github.com/motiondivision/motion (MIT)
Reference only: controlled native animation, visibility-aware pause and reduced-motion handling. Implemented with browser WAAPI/CSS; Motion is not installed.
Radix Primitives 84/100: https://github.com/radix-ui/primitives (MIT)
Reference only: named dialogs, focus return, keyboard navigation and controlled interaction state. Implemented using native dialog/details/button; React/Radix are not installed.

Lightning CSS 91/100: https://github.com/parcel-bundler/lightningcss (MPL-2.0)
Actual build-time tool, version 1.33.0: merges and conservatively minifies the existing CSS cascade into site.css.
Sharp 90/100: https://github.com/lovell/sharp (Apache-2.0)
Actual build-time tool, version 0.35.5: renders the original code-native sculpture into transparent responsive WebP assets and generates the share image.
Build tools and native binaries are not served to website visitors. See package-lock.json in the source repository.
SVGO 81/100: https://github.com/svg/svgo (MIT)
Evaluated but not used: syntax optimization would not remove the thousands of vector faces. The original SVG remains editable and serves as a fallback.

No upstream author is represented as participating in or endorsing this website.


本网站参考以下开源项目的信息组织、卡片布局与微交互思路，以原生 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 实现。
本次融合不安装或打包这些项目使用的 React、Next.js、Tailwind CSS、Motion 等框架依赖。
以下为来源与许可证存档；不表示原作者参与本站开发或为本站背书。
核验日期：2026-10-19。

app/page.tsx

========================================================================
ROUND 2 — DESIGN AND INTERACTION REFERENCES
第二轮设计与交互参考

本轮保留 v6 页面设计基础，借鉴交错图文案例、项目分类索引及命令菜单交互。
实际实现使用原生 HTML、CSS 与 JavaScript；不安装 Astro、React、Next.js、Tailwind 或 cmdk 运行依赖。
项目分类提供精选 / 历史 / 全部；快速导航采用原生 dialog、本地过滤及 Ctrl / Command + K、方向键、Enter、Escape 操作。
以下为来源及完整许可证存档，不表示上游作者参与本网站开发或为本网站背书。
核验日期：2026-10-19。

========================================================================
